questions.prompt: How many total active satellites are currently orbiting the Earth?
reasoning: Major commercial constellations like Starlink have added thousands of spacecraft in recent years
Government space agencies, scientific missions, and communication networks contribute several thousand more
Summing operational low Earth orbit, medium Earth orbit, and geostationary satellites yields approximately 9000

questions.prompt: How many total kilograms of carrots are produced globally in a single year?
reasoning: Global annual carrot and turnip production is roughly 40 million tonnes
Multiplying 40 million tonnes by 1000 gives 40 billion kilograms
